literal: Greatness [is] pride absence; smallness [is] pride having ridden completely.
translation: Greatness is the absence of pride. Smallness is being completely carried away by pride.
modern: பெருமை என்பது தற்பெருமை இல்லாமல் இருப்பதாகும். சிறுமை என்பது தற்பெருமையின் மீது ஏறிச் சவாரி செய்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts true greatness with smallness of character by looking at how they relate to pride. Greatness is defined simply as the complete absence of arrogance. Smallness, on the other hand, is depicted with the striking image of riding on pride, meaning the person is entirely driven and carried away by conceit. The word 'ஊர்ந்து' (riding or mounting) vividly shows how petty individuals let arrogance control their behavior.
